name: Python.org
body: Every page has a title and a description, and the text reads without JavaScript. The gap: its WebSite JSON-LD has no name, the property search uses for the site name in results.
lesson: Add "name" to your WebSite JSON-LD, written exactly as you want the site named in search results.
summary: www.python.org scores 86 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 20 structured data items miss a property Google expects.

fix.title: 20 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / WebSite lacks name, /psf-landing/ WebSite lacks name, /jobs/ WebSite lacks name and 17 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /psf-landing/, /jobs/, /community/ and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.
